text:
Priya: Heads up — ACME renewal paperwork hit a snag. Procurement uploaded PO PO-ACME-2026-114 with net30 but finance expects net45. DocuSign envelope failed when we tried to send to their CFO (alias email). Can AE/legal chime in? :thinking:
Owen: On it. I messaged their CFO (cfo@acme.co) and they said their forwarding alias might be blocking external sign requests. I can hop on a quick call, but want to avoid rework.
Maria: FYI onboarding sits at ~70% — if signature slips >5 business days we should consider delaying the feature rollout to avoid a bad experience for the customer.
Sam: We could accept net30 for the initial invoice as a one-off if GL/voucher lines are updated. Who can confirm procurement change + invoice flow? @LegalBot?
LegalBot: We need an authorized executive signature. If the CFO can't be added as an authorized DocuSign recipient from their account, two options: 1) have them add the alias to their DocuSign account or 2) accept a scanned wet signature with a PO amendment referencing our SOW. I can draft a short amendment.
DocuSignBot: Envelope 0x9c returned error: "Recipient not in account (alias)". Suggested actions: resend with recipient type "external signer" or update recipient email.
Priya: Ok — plan: Owen, please ask ACME to either add cfo@acme.co as signer in their DocuSign or send a scanned signed PO. Sam, please hold auto-invoice until we confirm GL code. Maria, I'll push their CSM contact for a confirmation call tomorrow 10am PT.
Owen: Scheduled call with ACME CFO 10:00am PT tomorrow. I'll request they add the alias and to confirm the billing terms.
Sam: I'll pause billing automation for this account and open a ticket to update the GL when we get the amended PO. Ticket: FIN-4821.
LegalBot: Drafting amendment now — will post a short redline in this thread in ~30m. If they prefer wet signature, we need the PO number + signatory name to match.
Priya: Thanks — if doc sign fails, we fall back to scanned PO + amendment. I'll post the call notes after the call. :thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks team — I'll prep a short enablement hold note for their CSM so they can set stakeholder expectations if rollout shifts.
Owen: Update after call: CFO said their internal security blocks third-party embedded sign links. They can upload a signed PDF to their procurement portal and email it. Asked me to cc procurement@acme.co.
Priya: Received — action items: 1) Owen to request signed PDF + cc procurement@acme.co 2) Sam to wait on billing automation 3) Legal to finalize amendment language referencing PO-ACME-2026-114 4) Priya to confirm rollout hold window with CSM.
Sam: Noted. Will only enable billing once we have a PO scan + amendment that matches terms.
LegalBot: Amendment draft uploaded: /docs/amendments/ACME_PO_114_amendment_v1.docx — key line: "Effective invoice terms: Net 45 (unless otherwise accepted in writing)". If they insist on net30 we need exec sign-off.
Priya: Closing loop: ACME emailed back signed PDF (attached), procurement cc'd. Owen forwarded to me and Legal. Legal — can you confirm amendment vs scanned PO match so I can unpause onboarding?
LegalBot: Reviewed — scanned PO references PO-ACME-2026-114 but still says Net 30. Amendment needs signing by our authorized rep to effect term change. Recommend we: a) sign amendment, b) accept net30 for first invoice only (documented), then transition to net45. Need confirmation from Finance.
Sam: Finance approves one-time net30 for first invoice if amendment is signed and GL lines are set. I'll proceed once Legal uploads the signed amendment.
Priya: Great — I'll coordinate signature and then mark onboarding/backlog accordingly. Thread closed when amendment is signed.
